description: AUTHORITATIVE historical daily weather for any location, back to 1940. Source: ERA5 reanalysis (ECMWF's global atmospheric reconstruction — the standard reference dataset for climate research). Pass a city or lat/lon + date range. Returns daily high/low temperature, precipitation, conditions. Defaults to the last 30 days if no dates given. Use for "what was the weather in X on date Y", climate baselines, comparing this year to historical averages, retrospective weather context for any event.

end_date.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Optional — defaults to today.

latitude.description: Latitude (alternative to location). Accepts lat as alias.

location.description: City name (e.g. "Tokyo", "London", "New York"). Resolved via Open-Meteo geocoding. Use this OR latitude+longitude. Accepts city, place, name as aliases.

longitude.description: Longitude (alternative to location). Accepts lng / lon as alias.

start_date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (>= 1940-01-01). Optional — defaults to 30 days ago.

name: get_historical
